landing.econ.1t: Invite the people close to you
landing.econ.1d: Share your invitation link. Every sign-up made with it is attached to you.
landing.econ.2market: Purchases on the Market, advertising, subscriptions: what Kinjy earns on their activity is tracked in your dashboard.
landing.econ.2plain: Advertising, subscriptions: what Kinjy earns on their activity is tracked in your dashboard.
landing.econ.3market: For example: someone you invited buys an item for $100. Kinjy adds $20 to the seller's price, and $4 of that comes to you.
landing.econ.3plain: On every dollar Kinjy earns through their activity, 20 cents comes to you.
landing.ask.tree: Who can see my family tree?
landing.plan.premium5: Switch ads on or off (on by default)
landing.trust.1title: Your messages, encrypted on our servers
landing.trust.1text: Messages and files are stored encrypted: a copy of the database reveals nothing. You decide who may write to you, invite you, or add you to their family.
landing.trust.2text: Deactivate or delete your account from your settings, with no reason to give.
landing.trust.3text: Every post says why it is being shown to you, and the Following mode stays strictly chronological.
landing.assistant.title: An assistant that speaks your language.
landing.assistant.text: Ask it a question about Kinjy, in writing or out loud. It answers in French, English, Swahili, Arabic or Chinese, and says where its answer came from.
landing.assistant.caption: Question asked in Swahili → answer in Swahili
landing.pricing.title: Start for free.
landing.pricing.text: All fifteen modules are available on the free plan. The paid plans add more advanced tools. Advertising is part of every plan, and Premium members can switch it off.
landing.trustSection.title: A safe place, by default.
landing.trustSection.text: Your data, your feed, your rules. Trust is not an option hidden in the settings.
landing.cta.title: Your tribe is waiting.
landing.cta.text: Free to join. Create your profile in under a minute.
landing.cta.sub: One account for the people close to you, your communities and your family.
landing.features.title: A network built for people, not for scrolling.
landing.features.communities: Cooking, climbing, records, code: join communities that share what you love, or start your own in two minutes.
landing.features.publishText: Photos, videos and articles, laid out. Simple tools to share something careful with the right people, and to choose who sees it.
landing.story.algoText: You decide what rises. Change mode whenever you like; nothing is imposed.
landing.story.formatsText: Write once. Kinjy turns it into an article, a newsletter and translations, which you read over before publishing. Video and audio come next.
landing.story.draftTitle: Our three-day crossing of the Vercors
landing.story.heritageText: Build your tree together, every link confirmed by your relatives, and open memorials where the family leaves what it remembers.
landing.story.econTitle: Earn with the network you grow.
landing.story.econText: of what Kinjy earns on what the people you invite do comes back to you.
landing.stores.soon: iOS and Android apps are coming. Kinjy works today in your browser, on a phone as well as a computer.

landing.modules.lead: Kinjy gathers what used to be scattered across ten apps.
landing.features.talk: Private messages and live rooms, in real time.
landing.features.talkCalls: Private messages in real time, live rooms and one-to-one calls.
landing.features.talkTail: Arrange the next outing without leaving your community.
signin.yourFingerprintOrFace: Your fingerprint or face unlocks your device locally — Kinjy never stores it.
signin.deactivateOrDeleteFrom: Deactivate or delete from your settings, with no justification asked and a cooling period you choose.
signin.weUseThisTo: We use this to give you the right experience for your age. It is not shown on your profile.
signin.creditsWhoeverInvitedYou: Credits whoever invited you — one level, 20% of our revenue on what you do.
memorials.aPermanentVerifiedPlace: A permanent, verified place of remembrance — biographies, voices, candles and flowers, visited from anywhere on Earth.
memorials.everyMemorialIsA: Every memorial is a whole life, carefully kept. Hover each element to see where it lives.
memorials.aCodeOnThe: A code on the stone. A world of memory behind it.
memorials.engravedQrPlaquesOpen: Engraved QR plaques open the memorial instantly — for visitors at the grave, and for generations who never knew them in person.
memorials.coordinatesCapturedAtThe: Coordinates captured at the grave are marked confirmed. Typed ones are marked not yet confirmed. They are never estimated, never fabricated.
memorials.neverAbandonedNeverVandalized: Never abandoned. Never vandalized. Never lost.
memorials.soonYouWillBe: Soon you will be able to name someone you trust to look after your account and your memorial wishes when you are gone — faith-style preferences included, exactly as you documented them, never inferred.
memorials.pointAPhoneAt: Point a phone at the resting place and see flowers, candles and stories gathered in augmented space.
memorials.askMeAboutMemorials: Ask me about memorials — I’m here to help, gently.
memorials.calendarWithThreeReminder: Calendar with three reminder rings: 10 days, 3 days, 6 hours before an anniversary
memorials.threeInterlockingRingsRepresen: Three interlocking rings representing up to three memorial administrators with named succession
reset.askText: Give us the address on your account and we will send a link to set a new password.
reset.sentText: If that address has a Kinjy account, a link is on its way. It lasts one hour and works once.
reset.couldNotAsk: Could not ask for a link. Try again in a moment.
reset.chooseText: This link works once. Setting a password here signs you in nowhere — you will sign in with the new one.
reset.rule: At least {{count}} characters, mixing letters with digits or symbols.
reset.ruleMix: Mix letters with digits or symbols.
reset.signsOutAll: Every device signed in to this account is signed out, including any you did not recognise.
reset.couldNotReset: Could not set the password. The link may have expired.
reset.doneText: Everything signed in before is signed out. Sign in with your new password.
reset.unavailableText: This installation cannot send mail yet, so a reset link cannot reach you. Please contact support.
